sourceEvidence.quote:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Fab Operations Manager/Director to oversee day-to-day manufacturing execution across our integrated production and technology development wafer fabs.

This critical operational leadership role requires balancing two competing priorities: maximizing tool utilization and wafer throughput for mature, revenue-generating high-volume manufacturing (HVM), while maintaining agility, engineering cycle time, and precise tool allocation for advanced technology development lots. You will lead cross-functional shift teams, establish real-time dispatch and WIP-management protocols, and cultivate a culture of safety, continuous improvement, and cross-functional operational discipline.
